docs.title: Kozahub Ingest Metadata Schema
docs.text:
LinkML schema for kozahub ingest run metadata: upstream source versions, transform/build versions, and output artifacts. Provides a kozahub-local vocabulary with semantic mappings to schema.org/Dataset, MLCommons Croissant, PROV-O, and translator-ingests' resource-ingest-guide-schema, so consumers can choose their preferred view.

URI: https://w3id.org/monarch/kozahub-metadata

Name: kozahub-metadata-schema

docs.title: Class: MappingVersion
docs.text:
A mapping file (typically SSSOM) consumed by this ingest. Distinct from a primary upstream SourceVersion because mapping versions have looser correctness implications — divergent mapping versions across contributing ingests are typically informational rather than build-breaking. Populated primarily by the merging layer (e.g. monarch-ingest) where mappings are applied to rewire IDs; individual ingests that consume mapping files for label-lookup or similar non-rewiring purposes generally need not populate this.

docs.title: Class: ReleaseMetadata
docs.text:
Release-level metadata for a single kozahub ingest build. Captures the upstream sources consumed, the artifacts produced, and the versions of the source data, ingest code, and dependencies relevant to reproducibility.

Scope note: this schema describes the release/build receipt only. Per-output-file content schemas (column-level / data-dictionary metadata derived from the produced TSVs) are a separate concern and will live in a sibling schema if added.
